result_text:
The parent report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape has no readable `config.json`. The change is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`, at line 156.

**What changed:** `addSubLandscapeRow` read `subLandscapeConfig.getMetadata()` without a null check. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returns `null` when the file is missing or unreadable, so that call was the NPE. It now falls back to `new Metadata()` when the config is null, which has an empty logo link. The existing `else` branch then renders the default landscape logo. The row still links to the sub-landscape's index page, and sub-landscapes with a config keep their own logo.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl reports compile` succeeds. There are no existing tests for the landscape report, so I did not add one. I did not run `updateLandscape` against a broken sub-landscape, so the end-to-end behavior is confirmed by reading the code, not by a run.

Nothing is committed.
